title: KAITO — Secret Guidance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, everyone. It's good to see you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good to see you too! Our School Festival went well and we're back to our usual schedule starting today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! That means we can do shows together again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay♪ Come on, Nene! Show us your enthusiasm too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Y-Yay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. By the way, how did you play go?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So much so that I had students who didn't get to see it coming up to me asking for another showing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's terrific.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know, right? Rui's advice, as well as yours, from when we were rehearsing definitely helped polish it to perfection. And let's not forget my incredible talent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But there's been something puzzling me since that show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was expecting the audience to be in tears after that rollercoaster of tragic emotions, but they burst into tears laughing. Was my script too much for them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. A mystery indeed...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Was it really that much fun?!
I wish I could've seen it too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too!
Can you at least tell us what it was about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah. Well, it was a tragedy about nine Romeos fighting to the death for Juliet's love.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They clash in a heated battle with sweat on their brows and blood gushing everywhere. They all fight passionately until the bitter end!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it does! It sounds weird, but it does!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, but I showed you some parts of it at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Perhaps we could do a performance here for everyone to enjoy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really, KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've seen some of their rehearsals, but not the entire play.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to see it performed in its entirety, if you'd be willing, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't say no to you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright then! Get ready for a special encore of Romeo: Battle Royale!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We'll need to prepare the stage and props.
Oh, we need to choose the actors too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even if everyone here was given part, we wouldn't be able to fill every role.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's ask Len and the plushies to join.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good thinking! I'll go find them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! We'll get everything set up in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on. What about the script?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No problem there. I have it saved to my phone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not that. I meant its content.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You said it was about a gory battle.
Isn't that too extreme for the plushies?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Removing fake bloodstains from them would be quite an ordeal, I imagine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose we could tone it down to make it suitable for all audiences, like our Wonder Stage shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for bringing that up, Nene. And Tsukasa, for being so accommodating.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, a star has to understand how his audience feels as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I'd better get started with revising the script then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay. Let me help you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, is that everyone?

rows.Speaker: Len & Plushies
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shall we assign who will be playing each Romeo now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In order of appearance we have: Hammer Romeo, who dies from stubbing his pinky toe; Tonfa Romeo, who dies from looking the wrong way...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hahaha! That's hilarious!
Their causes of death are too funny!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's more where that came from!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe! This is gonna be a tough choice♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Tsukasa really never fails to make people around him smile.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, most of the roles are assigned now.
Wait, KAITO doesn't have a role yet.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What will it be for me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You'll be Ninja Star Romeo, who dies from biting his tongue while speaking too fast!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, why don't I get a choice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that leaves...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: H-Hey, can't we discuss this...?!
